title: Customer Dashboards
seo: Customer dashboard development for SaaS products
meta: A clear customer dashboard that shows users their usage, activity and account at a glance. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Customer dashboards that show what matters
overview: We design and build the screen your customers see first after they log in. You tell us what a customer cares about, such as usage, recent activity, plan status or next steps, and we turn it into a clean dashboard with cards, charts and shortcuts. It connects to your own data, works on any screen size and comes with a short guide so your team can adjust it later.

pkgs.blurb: A simple home screen with the key numbers for each customer.
list: One dashboard page designed and built

pkgs.blurb: A richer dashboard with several charts and a recent activity feed.
A full customer area with several tabs and a getting-started guide.

faq: Which front-end tools do you use?
We work with React, Next.js, Vue and plain HTML with your existing styles. If you already have a stack, we match it so your own developers can keep editing the code.
Where does the data come from?
From your database or API. You give us read access or a test endpoint, and we shape the data for each card and chart. We never ask for your passwords.
Can you redesign a dashboard I already have?
Yes. Add us to the project, tell us what feels confusing and we reorganise the screen around what customers actually check. We confirm the scope in writing first.
Do you build the sign-in as well?
Not in this service. We assume users can already log in. Sign-in, roles and teams are covered in our user accounts services, which can be added if needed.
